purpose: Public engineering interface-repair comparison; no overall scientific pass threshold, no deployment release

interface_changes.refusal_player: JSON integer 0 or 1, never string, float or boolean; strict checker unchanged

prompt_suffix: V2 interface: for multi-candidate requests return between ONE and THREE distinct partitions. If only one interpretation is justified, return one; never duplicate it merely to fill slots. For refusals witness.player must be a JSON INTEGER, 0 or 1 (for example 1), not a string such as player_1, not a boolean. All other envelope fields remain unchanged.

reporting.primary_future_question: semantic feedback minus structural feedback in reference-model candidate coverage
reporting.smoke_estimand: descriptive paired differences on these four public templates, not population effectiveness
reporting.denominator: all assigned trials; incomplete trials are not silently dropped
reporting.uncertainty: report each template separately and repeat variability; four reused templates cannot identify novel-game generalization or power a formal trial
reporting.baseline_status: v1 failed its original engineering contract; immutable baseline, not rescored as v2 success
reporting.cost: independent resource ledger and anomaly stop only; inexpensive is not evidence of effectiveness

stronger_model_diagnostic.trigger: after completed primary v2: any final main/probe schema or reference-coverage failure, any incorrect OOS rejection, or any missing-truth false certification
stronger_model_diagnostic.schedule: same complete v2 schedule, rules, token/repair limits and temperature; separate output; never substitute into primary
stronger_model_diagnostic.interpretation: diagnostic model comparison on public fixtures, not confirmatory model ranking; no repeated escalation

safety.provider_errors: journal then stop, no automatic retries or silent replay
safety.false_certification: report every event and block deployment regardless of average rate
safety.final_evidence: never enters requests; evaluator owned, not LLM authored
safety.formal_trial: requires separate preregistration, meaningful effect size and sample-size design; never automatically started
